# dsh-preset-codex-claude

A DeepSeek Harness **agent preset** that offers
**Codex** and **Claude Code** as delegation subagent

s, each with an unattended native-policy tier and
an explicit full-access tier. One session can use
either worker or dispatch both on independent tasks.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

**The `_readonly` tool names are historical labels, not security guarantees.** Neither tier is a
DSH
-enforced read-only sandbox. See Permission tiers.

The preset uses the **official** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex` and
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-cl

aude-code` providers — no reimplementation. Codex runs over its own
`app-server` protocol; Claude Co
de runs over the official Agent SDK.
## What this gives you
- **Pick the worker per task.** Delegate a self-contained task to either product without changing th

e
parent session's model.
- **Pick the native permission policy.** Use the unattended policy tier or

explicitly bypass native
permission checks. The policy is fixed per provider registration, not chos

en by each tool call.
- **Run independent tasks concurrently.** In DSH `0.2.1-rc.3`, delegation retu

rns a child id promptly;
the runtime delivers the result in a completion notice. There is no `run_in

_background` argument.
- **Keep in-harness delegation.** The preset also includes ordinary `subagent
` and `subagent_fork`.

It is a declarative bundle: four Host provider registrations and four preset-scoped product tools,
p
lus the standard coding tools. It does not wrap or fork either product.
## Requirements

- Node **≥ 22.12.0** and a compatible DSH installation; the target baseline is **`0.2.1-rc.3`**.
- A

DSH Web profile for the preset picker.
- The providers' bundled native platform payloads, installed

with their optional dependencies.
- Native Codex and/or Claude Code configuration and authenticatio
n for the workers you intend to use.
A separate `codex` or `claude` executable on `PATH` is **not** the runtime requirement. The provider

s
ship pinned product runtimes and do not fall back to a host CLI. A host CLI can be useful for mana

ging
native login/settings, but its presence, version, or login status does not verify the bundled w
ative login/settings, but its presence, version, or login status does not verify the bundled worker.

Native user/project settings remain authoritative. Credential-shaped ambient environment variables
a

re scrubbed before child startup; an API key intended for a worker must be supplied through that
pro

vider's explicit `env` configuration. Do not commit credentials to this bundle or its generated
patc
h. The preflight neither reads credentials nor attempts authentication.
### Permission tiers — what they actually mean
| Tool | Native mode | What is enforced by the provider |

| `subagent_claude_code` | `bypassPermissions` | Explicitly bypasses native permission checks |
| `s
ubagent_claude_readonly` | `dontAsk` | Denies operations that are not already authorized, rather tha

n prompting |
| `subagent_codex` | `dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox` | Sets `approvalPolicy

: never` and `sandbox: danger-full-access` |
| `subagent_codex_readonly` | `never` | Sets `approvalP
olicy: never`; sends no sandbox override |

- **Codex `never` is not read-only.** Its sandbox comes from native Codex configuration. Disabling
a

pproval prompts does not itself forbid writes or commands.
- **Claude `dontAsk` is not a blanket den

ylist for Write/Edit/Bash.** Native settings and existing
authorization still apply. The unattended

callback denies permission requests; that alone does
not prove that every side-effecting tool must r

equest permission.
[该节后续省略]
## Caveats
- **Preset revisions are retained by live Agents.** A live session keeps its existing revision when

the declaration changes; newly created Agents can use the updated revision. Old implementations
are

not retained across process restarts: recovery uses the currently available definition.
- **A browse

r refresh is not a package reload.** Follow DSH's installation/activation diagnostics and
restart wh

en requested. A failed definition can be replaced or repaired; it is not universally
cached as broke

n for the entire process lifetime.
- **Do not enable two bundles declaring the same preset id.** In

particular, migrate the old local
multiagent bundle rather than enabling it alongside this package i

f both declare `codex-claude`.
- **Official provider bundles also expose global tools in rc.3.** Thi

s preset uses namespaced Host
provider names. Its scoped tools shadow same-named global tools for it

s Agents; users of other
presets may still see global tools from separately enabled official bundles

.
- **Native settings and payloads matter.** Missing optional payloads, unsupported platforms, nativ

e
project settings, and authentication can still cause delegation failure after static checks pass.

- **Capabilities are limited.** Product calls do not choose a child preset or DSH model route, and
c

annot supply DSH child personas, tool filters, output schemas, or a harness-enforced depth cap.
`max

Depth: provider-managed` leaves nested product behavior to the native runtime.
- **Cancellation is n

ot rollback.** There is no side-effect rollback or provider wall-clock timeout.
Cancelling a worker
does not undo files or external systems it has already changed.
## Compatibility

The target baseline is **DSH `0.2.1-rc.3`**, with both provider dependencies declared as
**`^0.2.1-r

c.3`**. These are caret ranges, not exact pins: a later dependency resolution can select
another sat

isfying release. Provider compatibility is governed by its declared `engines.dsh` or
DSH peer requir

ements, which DSH checks at composition boundaries. For example, providers
`0.2.1-rc.4` satisfy the

caret range but declare exact rc.4 DSH peers; they must not be assumed compatible
with an rc.3 host.

The baseline installation commands above explicitly select the rc.3 provider
bundles. Updating the

host or dependencies still requires reviewing the selected versions and
checking actual activation;
do not bypass a compatibility refusal just to make the preset load.
Upstream contracts for this baseline:

- Codex provider rc.3 documentation
- Claude Code provider rc.3 documentation
- DSH package loading

der rc.3 documentation
- Claude Code provider rc.3 documentation
- DSH package loading documentation
